disclaimer: Platform-informed screening simulation based on public Lever documentation. Lever does not expose a universal fit percentage; no Lever score is produced here.

scenarios.title: Rapid recruiter review (Fast Resume Review)
scenarios.description: A recruiter reviews resume, profile and answers sequentially and advances, archives or skips.

scenarios.title: Candidate search and filtering
scenarios.description: Boolean search across parsed resume text, notes and feedback; results sort by last interaction, not by fit score.

scenarios.title: Tag or workflow-supported review
scenarios.description: Employer-configured workflows may tag or archive based on answers or data where the package allows.

scenarios.title: Optional Talent Fit / third-party screening
scenarios.description: Package-dependent Talent Fit gives a job-specific binary assessment with explanation; third-party screening is separately provided.
